query: update cloud_jobs set source_url=null, webhook_url=case when webhook_delivered_at is not null or webhook_attempts>=$1 or expires_at<=now()-interval '6 hours' then null else webhook_url end, updated_at=now() where expires_at<=now() and (source_url is not null or (webhook_url is not null and (webhook_delivered_at is not null or webhook_attempts>=$1 or expires_at<=now()-interval '6 hours')))
